1.word_for_word: अष्टमे देह-संबन्धम् आक्षिपन्न् ईश-जीवयोः । — In the eighth, he attributes the relationship between the body and the living entities.; बहून् परीक्षिद् आपृच्छत् पुराणार्थान् बुभुत्सितान् ॥ — He examined many people and asked them about the meaning of the Purāṇas.; त्वम् एतद् विपुलीकुर्व् इत्य् उक्तं तद् एव विपुलीकरणं पृच्छति—ब्रह्मणेति त्रिभिः । — When it is said, “You shall expand this,” he asks for the same expansion—to the Brahman, by three.; अगुणस्य गुणातीतस्यापि । — Even of the unqualified and transcendental.; देववद् दर्शनं यस्य सः ॥१-२॥ — He whose vision is like that of a god.1-2
1.translation: In the eighth, he attributes the relationship between the body and the living entities. He examined many people and asked them about the meaning of the Purāṇas. When it is said, “You shall expand this,” he asks for the same expansion—to the Brahman, by three. Even of the unqualified and transcendental. He whose vision is like that of a god.1-2

2.word_for_word: त्वम् एतद् विपुलीकुर्व् इत्य् उक्तं तद् एव विपुलीकरणं पृच्छति—ब्रह्मणेति त्रिभिः । — When it is said, “You shall expand this,” he asks for the same expansion—to the Brahman, by three.; अगुणस्य गुणातीतस्यापि । — Even of the unqualified and transcendental.; देववद् दर्शनं यस्य सः ॥१-२॥ — He whose vision is like that of a god.1-2
2.translation: When it is said, “You shall expand this,” he asks for the same expansion—to the Brahman, by three. Even of the unqualified and transcendental. He whose vision is like that of a god.1-2

3.word_for_word: निःसङ्गं मनः श्री-कृष्णे निवेश्येति स्व-प्रयत्नो दर्शितः ॥३॥ — He has shown his own effort to fix his mind on Lord Kṛṣṇa without attachment.
3.translation: He has shown his own effort to fix his mind on Lord Kṛṣṇa without attachment.

4.word_for_word: सोऽपि श्रद्धया शृण्वतो नावश्यक इत्य् आह—शृण्वत इति । — He also argued that it was not necessary for one to listen with faith—that one should listen.; स्व-प्रयत्नं विनापि भगवान् स्वयम् एव हृदि विशति ॥४॥ — The Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself enters the heart even without His own effort.
4.translation: He also argued that it was not necessary for one to listen with faith—that one should listen. The Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself enters the heart even without His own effort.

5.word_for_word: भाव-सरोरुहं हृदय-कमलं प्रविष्टश् च तद्-गतं सर्वं मलं धुनोति। — He enters the lotus of the heart, the lotus of emotion, and washes away all the dirt that has entered it.; सलिलस्येति । — Salilsyeti.; द्रव्यान्तर-व्यामिश्रणादिना कुम्भ-स्थे जले शोधिते तद् एव केवलं शुध्यति न तु नदी-तडागादि-गतम्, स च मलः कुम्भस्यान्तस् तिष्ठत्य् एव न तु सर्वथा विलीयते । — When the water in the pot is purified by mixing other substances, it is only that which is purified, not that which has gone into rivers, ponds, etc., and the dirt remains inside the pot but does not dissolve at all.; अत एव किंचिच् चलनेन पुनः क्षुभ्यति च । — That’s why it’s moving a little bit and it’s shaking again.; एवं तपोदानादि प्रायश्चित्तं न सर्वथा सर्वेषां सर्वं पापं धुनोति, किन्तु सावशेषम्, तच् च कस्यचिद् एव, किंचिद् एव, हृदि प्रविष्ट-मात्रस् तु श्री-कृष्णः सर्वेषां सर्वं पापं निःशेषं हरतीत्य् अनेन दृष्टान्तेनोक्तं—सलिलस्य मलं यथा शरद् इति ॥५॥ — Thus atonement, such as austerities and charity, does not at all wash away all the sins of all, but with the remainder, and that is only a little of anyone, but as soon as Lord Kṛṣṇa enters the heart, He takes away all the sins of all without remainder.
5.translation: He enters the lotus of the heart, the lotus of emotion, and washes away all the dirt that has entered it. Salilsyeti. When the water in the pot is purified by mixing other substances, it is only that which is purified, not that which has gone into rivers, ponds, etc., and the dirt remains inside the pot but does not dissolve at all. That’s why it’s moving a little bit and it’s shaking again. Thus atonement, such as austerities and charity, does not at all wash away all the sins of all, but with the remainder, and that is only a little of anyone, but as soon as Lord Kṛṣṇa enters the heart, He takes away all the sins of all without remainder.

6.word_for_word: ततश् च कृतार्थो भवतीत्य् आह । — And then he is satisfied, he argues.; धौतात्मा निष्पापः । — The washed soul is sinless.; मुक्ताः सर्वे राग-द्वेषादयः परिक्लेशा येन । — By Him all attachment, hatred and other troubles are freed.; पान्थः प्रवासाद् आगतः स्वस्य शरणं गृहं यथा न मुञ्चति, तद्वत् ॥६॥ — Just as a traveler who has come from exile does not leave his home for his refuge
6.translation: And then he is satisfied, he argues. The washed soul is sinless. By Him all attachment, hatred and other troubles are freed. Just as a traveler who has come from exile does not leave his home for his refuge

7.word_for_word: तद् एवं श्रवणौत्सुक्यम् आविष्कृत्य सन्दिग्धान् अर्थान् पृच्छति । — That’s how he discovers he’s curious to hear it and asks for doubtful meanings.; अधातुमतः धातवो महा-भूतानि तत्-संबन्ध-शून्यस्यास्य लौकिकस्यात्मनो जीवस्य धातुभिर् देहारम्भ इति यत् । — The elements of the non-metallic are the great beings, and this worldly self, which is devoid of any relationship with them, is the beginning of the body with the elements.; एतत् किम् ? — What is this ?; यदृच्छया निर्निमित्तं हेतुना वा कर्मादिना भवन्तो यथावज् जानते । — You know exactly what happened by chance, without cause, by reason, or by action.; अतः कथयन्त्व् इति शेषः ॥७॥ — Therefore let them tell the rest.
7.translation: That’s how he discovers he’s curious to hear it and asks for doubtful meanings. The elements of the non-metallic are the great beings, and this worldly self, which is devoid of any relationship with them, is the beginning of the body with the elements. What is this ? You know exactly what happened by chance, without cause, by reason, or by action. Therefore let them tell the rest.

8.word_for_word: यश् चासाव् ईश्वरः, सोऽप्य् एतत्-तुल्य-देहवान् प्रोक्तः, अतस् तस्य को विशेषः ? — Who is also God, is said to have a body like this, so what is the difference between him?; इत्य् आशयेन पृच्छति—आसीद् इति सार्धेन । — He asks with the intention of—with the intention of saying it was.; लोकानां संस्थानं रचना, तद् एव लक्षणं स्वरूपं यस्य, तत् त्रैलोक्यात्मकं पद्मं यस्योदराद् आसीत् । — The creation of the institution of the worlds, and that is the characteristic form of the Lord, was the lotus of the three worlds from His belly.; असाव् ईश्वर इयत्ता-युक्तैः स्व-परिमितैर् अवयवैर् अयं लौकिकः पुरुषो यावान् यत्-सङ्ख्याकावयव-युक्तः, तावान् प्रोक्तः संस्थावान्, अवयववान् इव च प्रोक्तः । — Asav God is said to have as many parts as he has, and is said to have as many parts as he has, and is said to have as many parts as he has.; अतः को विशेषस् तस्य ? — So what’s special about it?; इति ॥८॥ — It is said.
8.translation: Who is also God, is said to have a body like this, so what is the difference between him? He asks with the intention of—with the intention of saying it was. The creation of the institution of the worlds, and that is the characteristic form of the Lord, was the lotus of the three worlds from His belly. Asav God is said to have as many parts as he has, and is said to have as many parts as he has, and is said to have as many parts as he has. So what’s special about it? It is said.

9.word_for_word: अवश्यं च विशेषो वाच्य इत्य् आह । — And of course, he argues, the special is to be said.; अजो ब्रह्मा भूतानां व्यष्ट्य्-उपाधीनाम् आत्मा नियन्ता, समष्ट्य्-उपाधित्वात् । — The unborn Brahman is the controller of the Self of all beings, who are subject to the whole, since He is the subject of the whole.; येन चानुगृह्णता तस्य रूपं ददृशे दृष्टवान् । — He saw the form of the Lord by whom he had been shown mercy; एतच् च— “तस्यापि द्रष्टुर् ईशस्य कूटस्थस्याखिलात्मनः । — And this is also said: “The seer of that also is the Lord, the unchanging, all-pervading Soul.; सृज्यं सृजामि सृष्टोऽहम् ईक्षयैवाभिचोदितः ॥” इत्य् अनेन पूर्वम् उक्तम् ॥९॥ — I create whatever I create, and I am created, and I am inspired by the sight.” This has been said before.
9.translation: And of course, he argues, the special is to be said. The unborn Brahman is the controller of the Self of all beings, who are subject to the whole, since He is the subject of the whole. He saw the form of the Lord by whom he had been shown mercy And this is also said: “The seer of that also is the Lord, the unchanging, all-pervading Soul. I create whatever I create, and I am created, and I am inspired by the sight.” This has been said before.

10.word_for_word: प्रश्नान्तरम् आह—स चापीति । — The other question is that he is also.; यत्र शेते येन रूपेणावतिष्ठते । — Wherever he lies, he remains in whatever form he takes.; विश्वस्य स्थित्य्-आदयो यस्मात् । — From which the universe is created.; एवम्-आदि-प्रश्नानां तत्त्वतोऽर्हस्य् उदाहर्तुम् इति सर्वान्ते क्रियया सम्बन्धः ॥१०॥ — Thus, in the beginning of the questions, it is in fact worthy of you to give an example, and at the end of all, the relation is to the action.
10.translation: The other question is that he is also. Wherever he lies, he remains in whatever form he takes. From which the universe is created. Thus, in the beginning of the questions, it is in fact worthy of you to give an example, and at the end of all, the relation is to the action.

11.word_for_word: [विष्वास-प्रस्तुतौ अस्मिन् श्लोके पृथक् श्रीधर-स्वामी-व्याख्या न प्रदत्ता।] — [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.
11.translation: [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.

12.word_for_word: एवं सन्देह-विपर्ययाभ्यां पृष्टम्, इदानीम् अज्ञातान् बहून् अर्थान् पृच्छति—यावान् इत्य्-आदिना । — Thus asked by both doubt and contradiction, he now asks for many unknown meanings—by saying, “Yavan,” etc.; कल्पो महान् । — The Kalpa is great.; विकल्पोऽवान्तरः । — The alternative is the difference.; भूतादिः शब्दो यस्मात्, यस्य वाचक इति वा । — or from which a word, such as a ghost, is derived.; सतः स्थूल-देहाभिमानिनो मनुष्य-पितृ-देवादेर् आयुषः प्रमाणम् ॥१२॥ — The measure of the life span of the true man, father, god and others who are proud of their gross bodies.
12.translation: Thus asked by both doubt and contradiction, he now asks for many unknown meanings—by saying, “Yavan,” etc. The Kalpa is great. The alternative is the difference. or from which a word, such as a ghost, is derived. The measure of the life span of the true man, father, god and others who are proud of their gross bodies.

13.word_for_word: अनुमान-प्रकारः पृष्टो विशेषं पृच्छति—कालस्येति । — The type of inference asked asks specifically—of time.; अनुगतिः प्रवृत्तिः । — Following is instinct.; कर्म-गतयः कर्म-प्राप्याणि स्थानानि । — The movements of action are the places where action is attained.; यादृशीः यादृश्यः ॥१३॥ — Whatever they are, whatever they are.
13.translation: The type of inference asked asks specifically—of time. Following is instinct. The movements of action are the places where action is attained. Whatever they are, whatever they are.

14.word_for_word: [विष्वास-प्रस्तुतौ अस्मिन् श्लोके पृथक् श्रीधर-स्वामी-व्याख्या न प्रदत्ता।] — [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.
14.translation: [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.

15.word_for_word: भू-पातालादीनां सम्भवः । — The possibility of the earth and the underworld.; एतान्य् ओकांसि येषां प्राणिनां, तेषां च सम्भवः । — These oaks are the source of the animals that live in them.; यथेति सर्वत्रानुषङ्गः ॥१५॥ — As, it is everywhere attached.
15.translation: The possibility of the earth and the underworld. These oaks are the source of the animals that live in them. As, it is everywhere attached.

16.word_for_word: वर्णानाम् आश्रमाणां च विनिश्चयस् तत्-तत्-स्वभावैर् निर्धारः ॥१६॥ — The determination of the varnas and the āśramas is determined by their respective natures.
16.translation: The determination of the varnas and the āśramas is determined by their respective natures.

17.word_for_word: युगे युगे प्रतियुगं यो धर्मो यच् च हरेर् अवतारानुचरितम् ॥१७॥ — The religious principles followed in every age and in every age by the incarnations of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
17.translation: The religious principles followed in every age and in every age by the incarnations of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

18.translation: [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.

20.translation: [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.

21.word_for_word: सम्प्लवोऽवान्तर-प्रलयः । — The flood is the intermediate catastrophe.; यद् वा, सम्यक् प्लवनम् उद्भवः, विक्रमः स्थितिः, प्रतिसंक्रमो महा-प्रलयः, इष्टं वैदिकं कर्म, पूर्तं स्मार्तं— “वापी-कूप-तडागादि देवता-यतनानि च । — That is, the perfect floating, the origin, the prowess, the position, the retransition, the great doom, the desired Vedic ritual, the fulfilled memory— “and the temples of the gods, such as wells, wells, ponds, etc.; अन्न-प्रदानम् आरामः पूर्तम् इत्य् अभिधीयते ॥” इति वा । — Giving food is called comfort and fulfillment.” or so on.; काम्यानां काम्य-कर्मणाम् । — They are desirable and desirable.; त्रि-वर्गस्य धर्मार्थ-कामस्य । — of the three classes of religion, wealth and desire.; विधिर् अविरोध-प्रकारः ॥२१॥ — The method is the type of non-contradiction.
21.translation: The flood is the intermediate catastrophe. That is, the perfect floating, the origin, the prowess, the position, the retransition, the great doom, the desired Vedic ritual, the fulfilled memory— “and the temples of the gods, such as wells, wells, ponds, etc. Giving food is called comfort and fulfillment.” or so on. They are desirable and desirable. of the three classes of religion, wealth and desire. The method is the type of non-contradiction.

22.word_for_word: अनुशायिनां लीनोपाधीनां जीवानाम् । — They are lying down and absorbed in the living entities.; आत्मनो जीवस्य । — of the soul of the living being.; व्यवस्थानं बन्ध-मोक्षातिरिक्त-स्वरूपेणावस्थानम् ॥२२॥ — The arrangement is the state of being in a form other than bondage and liberation.
22.translation: They are lying down and absorbed in the living entities. of the soul of the living being. The arrangement is the state of being in a form other than bondage and liberation.

23.word_for_word: [विष्वास-प्रस्तुतौ अस्मिन् श्लोके पृथक् श्रीधर-स्वामी-व्याख्या न प्रदत्ता।] — [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.
23.translation: [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.

24.word_for_word: च-शब्दाद् अपृष्टम् अपि ॥२४॥ — Even unquestioned by the word cha.
24.translation: Even unquestioned by the word cha.

25.word_for_word: [विष्वास-प्रस्तुतौ अस्मिन् श्लोके पृथक् श्रीधर-स्वामी-व्याख्या न प्रदत्ता।] — [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.
25.translation: [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation is given in this verse in the presentation of faith.

26.word_for_word: ननु तवानशन-द्विज-कोपाभ्यां व्याकुलस्य कुतः श्रवणम् ? — Where, then, can I hear you, troubled by your fasting and the wrath of the Brāhmaṇas?; तत्राह—नेति । — There he argues that it is not.; न परायन्ति नापगच्छन्ति । — They don’t run away or go away.; न व्याकुलीभवन्तीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that they are not disturbed.; अच्युत-कीर्ति-पीयूषम् ॥२६॥ — The nectar of the infallible fame.
26.translation: Where, then, can I hear you, troubled by your fasting and the wrath of the Brāhmaṇas? There he argues that it is not. They don’t run away or go away. This means that they are not disturbed. The nectar of the infallible fame.

27.word_for_word: उपामन्त्रितः पृष्टः । — The invited guest asked.; संश् चासौ पतिश् च तस्य ॥२७॥ — Sansh and his husband.
27.translation: The invited guest asked. Sansh and his husband.

28.word_for_word: ब्रह्म-कल्पे सृष्ट्य्-उपक्रम-कल्पे । — In the Brahma-kalpa, in the kalpa of the initiation of creation.; भागवताख्यानेनैव प्रश्नानाम् उत्तरं दातुम् उपक्रान्तवान् इत्य् अर्थः ॥२८॥ — This means that he began to answer the questions by the narrative of the Bhagavad-gītā.
28.translation: In the Brahma-kalpa, in the kalpa of the initiation of creation. This means that he began to answer the questions by the narrative of the Bhagavad-gītā.

29.word_for_word: पाण्डूनाम् ऋषभः श्रेष्ठः । — The bull is the best of the Pandavas.; आनुपूर्व्येणेति प्रस्ताव-क्रमोऽत्र विवक्षितो न प्रश्न-क्रमः ॥२९॥ — The order of proposals is defined here as in order, not the order of questions.
29.translation: The bull is the best of the Pandavas. The order of proposals is defined here as in order, not the order of questions.
